scope: Media, visualization, motion and day agenda; all22 exported component identities, including aliases. Internal helpers inspected with owning export.
verification_environment: Node/React test renderer, actual dependency hooks with deterministic host/engine adapters where noted, SSR and source/model checks. Browser execution was unavailable under the sandbox; no browser/device/performance/crash claim.
immutable_inputs: NodeGraph nodes/edges and changed item/data objects must be replaced together; Radar axes/series and nested changed records/data must be replaced; DayAgenda events must be replaced. In-place mutation is not an invalidation signal. Public prop comments and docs/performance-media.md record this explicitly.

findings: Callback identity previously propagated into source loading, so replacing onStateChange reloaded and paused the same audio. Latest-callback refs now preserve native listener and source-effect lifetime.

Identical native snapshots no longer enqueue React state; every native event still delivers its callback. Source-version and detached-element checks ignore stale play rejection after source replacement/unmount.
Inspected native listener removal, source resets, pending play rejection, controlled controls/renderControls and imperative callbacks.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: callback replacement, identical snapshot, stale play rejection/source/unmount cases
Baseline callback-only update loaded source twice; candidate loads once.
browser_only_gaps: Native decoding, autoplay policy, browser buffering/error ordering and actual media playback remain browser-only.

findings: Controlled selection previously changed Embla startIndex options and rebuilt the engine. Options are now memoized on actual engine configuration/plugins; selection is synchronized with scrollTo.
Genuine option/plugin reInit takes the latest desired selection, avoiding reset to the mount index.
Inspected Embla delegated resize/slides/drag, direction observer cleanup, autoplay hover/focus/reduced-motion stop/resume and destroy lifecycle.
verification: packages/inkra/test/carousel-performance.test.mjs: real Embla React hook plus deterministic engine/plugin adapters; three controlled changes cause zero reInit versus three on baseline; align/loop/plugin changes retain index2
packages/inkra/test/carousel.test.mjs: SSR, keyboard/RTL, autoplay source contracts
browser_only_gaps: Browser inertia, snapping geometry, touch/RTL, autoplay timing and visibility/resize behavior are not exercised by adapters.

findings: Stable event/locale/config snapshots now reuse interval normalization, sort/layout, ticks, labels, date and time formatters. Selection-only rerenders do not reconstruct geometry.
Lane allocation uses occupied-end and lowest-available-lane heaps; occupancy uses a sorted sweep, and position uses binary search. Lowest lane, id ties, grouping and point placement remain unchanged.
Inspected time zone/locale/day clipping, point/untimed events, selection semantics, accessible summary and navigation; no animation or global subscription in this component.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: twenty-event mount uses two Intl formatters versus66 on baseline; selection adds zero constructors/interval reads
packages/inkra/test/agenda-layout-performance.test.mjs:150 seeded original-algorithm equivalence cases,1000-interval endpoint reads reduced from1501500 to5996,20000 overlaps
scripts/verify-media-equivalence.mjs: locales, hour cycles, density, point/cross-day/untimed SSR parity
browser_only_gaps: Actual card/text geometry and scrolling at large event counts require browser profiling; full accessible content remains mounted.

findings: Inspected CSS-driven face rotation, controlled/uncontrolled state, focus transfer on changed face and inactive face inert/aria-hidden.
No custom animation loop or timer; rerender on flipped/enabled state is semantic. No direct change justified; composition benefits from Tilt coalescing.
verification: scripts/verify-media-equivalence.mjs: both controlled faces match baseline SSR
browser_only_gaps: Actual focus transfer, inert support, reduced-motion and 3D compositing need browser validation.

findings: Inspected button semantics, caller onClick/defaultPrevented, explicit target state, disabled/enabled and aria-pressed context updates.
No loops/listeners/large derived collection. Context changes are required for pressed state; no independent optimization justified.
browser_only_gaps: Keyboard/focus behavior with real nested controls remains browser-only.

findings: Coalesces accepted pointer samples to one animation frame, using latest coordinates and one layout measurement/style update. Consumer pointer handlers still receive every event.
Cancels pending work on leave, cancel, disabled, reduced motion and unmount. Stable reset callback avoids unnecessary reduced-motion listener replacement.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs:101 pointer events yield one layout read versus101 on baseline; latest coordinates/caller count/reset/cancellation/listener cleanup asserted
browser_only_gaps: Actual pointer-to-paint latency, CSS transitions and GPU/compositor behavior require browser measurements.

findings: Inspected memoized key lookup, matrix, finite extrema and D3 scales, missing values/typed keys, hover/focus/click semantics and full accessible table.
No custom animation loop/global listener; extrema already iterative. No measured redundant lifecycle or derivation requiring a safe change.
Matrix DOM and interaction render work remain proportional to rows times columns. Virtualization would change table/accessibility semantics and was not introduced without evidence.
browser_only_gaps: Dense-matrix hover/render/paint cost and assistive-technology experience still require browser profiling.

findings: Repeated identical ResizeObserver stage measurements previously allocated state and rerendered; updater now reuses equal width/height state.
Inspected object URL replacement/revocation, source reset, engine gesture callbacks, export buffer caps and finally-zeroed canvas; kept output format and crop behavior unchanged.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: five repeated same-size observer callbacks add zero commits versus five on baseline; changed size adds one; observer disconnect asserted
browser_only_gaps: Image decode, EXIF orientation, native file loading, crop gestures, cross-origin taint, memory pressure and real output pixels require browser checks.

findings: Coalesces rotate-fit and thumbnail-focus requests to at most one pending frame each and cancels them at unmount.
Fit callback verifies active image identity so a queued rotation cannot fit the newly selected image.
Inspected image-key remount, retry/error states, keyboard navigation, thumbnail refs and PanZoom integration; no arbitrary image preload expansion.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: ten rotations retain one pending fit frame versus ten; focus/fit queues and unmount cleanup asserted
browser_only_gaps: Portal opening/focus trap, actual image decoding, thumbnail focus and zoom/rotation geometry need browser validation; test renderer inspects closed-portal element props.

findings: Inspected memoized context, controlled/uncontrolled open/selection, missing-item repair guard, item changes and select callback dependencies.
No custom loop or native subscription. Selection lookup is linear but no safe measured bottleneck established; no change justified.
browser_only_gaps: Portal/open-close/focus behavior and controlled parent interaction need real browser coverage.

findings: Thin forwarded OverlayTrigger composition; inspected prop/ref forwarding and semantic delegated behavior.
No local animation, observer, collection computation or state; no independent optimization justified.
browser_only_gaps: Actual focus restoration and trigger keyboard interaction depend on Overlay browser integration.

findings: Terrain bounds now scan nested rings instead of flattening and passing entire coordinate collections to Math.min/max; large polygon input no longer exceeds JavaScript argument limits.

Inspected dynamic-import cancellation, map removal, stationary paint frame coalescing, transform-during-pan raster strategy, terrain scale bounds, resize/style/scheme observer cleanup and internal MapScale.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs:200000-vertex offscreen polygon processes without RangeError; baseline throws
browser_only_gaps: Leaflet map mount, tile loading, real map pan/zoom, canvas pixels, geographic projection and device-memory behavior require browser validation.

findings: Three fixed semantic buttons delegate zoom/fit to React Flow. Inspected labels, fit options, native button semantics and no local loop/listener.
Only trivial action allocations; no evidence justifies changing callback or context behavior.
browser_only_gaps: Real viewport animation and focus interaction remain browser-only.

findings: SVG path sampling now occurs only after a raster cache miss, rather than before checking unchanged paint/cached raster.
Inspected bounded96-entry/24MiB cache, canvas dimension/pixel/sample caps, SVG fallback, recovery invalidation, scheduling cancellation and observer cleanup; retained keys, seeds and hit target.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: unchanged paint and cached remount do not resample SVG; unmount cancels queued repaint
browser_only_gaps: Native SVG path metrics, canvas pixels/fallback, drag visual continuity and browser recovery need browser verification.

findings: Inspected label/description/content, read-only port connectability and selected/dragging styling. Internal DefaultNodeRenderer already memoized.
No local loop/listener. Preserving wrapper identity in Root lets existing renderer memoization work; no direct node markup change justified.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: Root unchanged node identity and render/readOnly invalidation
browser_only_gaps: Real drag/select/readOnly focus and accessibility behavior depend on React Flow browser integration.

findings: Inspected React Flow Handle forwarding and viewport-zoom subscription. Inverse zoom scale intentionally keeps the hit target usable.
Zoom-driven update is semantic; no custom loop or observer and no safe change justified.
browser_only_gaps: Real connection gestures, inverse-scale hit testing and zoom behavior require browser validation.

findings: WeakMap adapters reuse untouched input-node/edge wrappers across immutable single-record edits, instead of rebuilding every wrapper/data payload.
Weak keys do not retain removed input records; readOnly/renderNode/renderEdge/renderEdgeLabel configuration changes replace relevant adapter caches.

Inspected provider/SSR handover, imperative viewport refs, controlled nodes/edges/viewport, event forwarding and engine visibility options. Inputs must be immutable snapshots, now documented on public props.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: one replaced node/edge changes only its wrapper; sibling identity and readOnly/render callback invalidation asserted
browser_only_gaps: Actual engine node reconciliation, large graph dragging/viewport churn and heap retention need browser profiling. Mutating an existing item in place is not supported by the new per-record cache.

findings: Exact-decimal-string Intl support is now probed once per module rather than constructing another formatter on each decimal animation frame.
Inspected frame ownership, rapid retarget continuation, duration/end state, reduced-motion cleanup, delta timer, formatter memoization, digit limits and512-digit animation cutoff.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: ten decimal formatting calls create zero capability-probe formatters after warmup versus ten on baseline; retarget/reduced-motion/unmount retain/cancel one frame
browser_only_gaps: Real Intl compatibility on supported browser engines, intermediate visual text, announcements and paint performance require browser/device checks.

findings: Removed unused uncontrolled React state updates from every engine transform; committedRef retains imperative value while the engine owns DOM transforms.
Inspected native engine cleanup, callbacks/reasons, controlled value synchronization, gesture-end reconciliation, bounds and imperative transforms; no engine API changes.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: ten engine frames add zero wrapper commits versus ten on baseline; callbacks and imperative snapshot preserved; explicit external controlled change/four refused gesture ends/latest callback/maxScale checks
browser_only_gaps: Real pan/wheel/pinch, ResizeObserver geometry, focus and engine animation need browser verification.

findings: Memoized visible series, angles, per-axis scales and shared point geometry eliminate repeated derivation and canvas-effect churn on selection/unrelated renders.
Indexed first-point lookup retains duplicate-first behavior and distinguishes string/number keys; NaN keys retain original strict-equality behavior. Canvas/SVG/summary/table share geometry.
Iterative extrema replace unbounded argument spreads; inspected canvas fallback, cache key, resize/inherited-style/scheme/recovery cleanup and selected-series accessibility.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: selection/unrelated rerenders add zero value reads versus48 on baseline; immutable data replacement invalidates;200000-value series avoids RangeError
scripts/verify-media-equivalence.mjs: duplicate/typed/NaN keys, axes, domains, hidden series and selection match baseline SSR
browser_only_gaps: Canvas pixel parity, SVG fallback switching, real observer delivery and large axis/series DOM scale require browser validation.

findings: Domain and summary extrema now use loops rather than unbounded spreads. Initial active-index reverse search is lazy and does not copy/reverse data on each render.
Memoized summary preserves no-data and accessible numeric text. Inspected existing normalization/geometry memoization, keyboard/pointer state, missing-point handling and canvas fallback cleanup.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs:200000-point domain succeeds where baseline throws RangeError
scripts/verify-media-equivalence.mjs: line/bar/empty/missing/constant values match baseline SSR
browser_only_gaps: Actual pointer hit-testing, canvas/pencil pixels, resize recovery and data-size memory/paint costs need browser validation; full normalization still scales with input.

findings: Memoized private grapheme leaf prevents unchanged PencilText leaves from rerendering on each reveal while preserving all mounted graphemes, seeds and selectable/assistive content.
Inspected single timer lifecycle, pause/resume/restart/replacement/completion/unmount and reduced-motion behavior; parent mapping remains linear in grapheme count.
verification: packages/inkra/test/media-performance.test.mjs: revealing one of six graphemes changes only that leaf props; timer lifecycle and cleanup asserted
browser_only_gaps: Actual timer-to-paint cadence, selection continuity, font shaping and assistive announcements require browser validation.
